comparisonBasis: Approved Chapter2 Bureau and Control Tower at native314x206 and exact4x
Approved Chapter4 lobby/restroom for architecture/material continuity
Preserved B2-02 v01 and detailed concepts
Direct-transfer diagnostic versus separate material/native structural layers

findings.composition: All four retain the established salvage staging, object placement/humor, truck/staircase, sofa/trolley, two piano workers and foreman, chandelier/container and cake trolley. No story keys or routes changed.
findings.pixelClusters: Material ramps and native structural layers replace near-identical shades and sampled quiet-surface texture with clearer regions. Purposeful isolated highlights, bolts, lettering, damask and leaf clusters are retained where they carry information. Small-component counts remain diagnostics, not a pass threshold.
findings.perspective: Elevator insets, door/support edges, floor vanishing-point grout, stair tread/rail, loading ramp and drain geometry inspected at target grid. Layer masks preserve actor/prop occlusion while floors are reconstructed.
findings.lighting: Explicit stepped floor/light/shadow planes and material ramps preserve the reference light hierarchy; no smooth native gradients or photographic grain stage.
findings.materials: Stone/tile, chipped plaster/brick, worn green steel, cooler duct metal, copper, wood, velvet, piano lacquer/ivory and chandelier metal retain different clustered treatment. Fine original marks are selected rather than all carried over.
findings.sceneNPCs: Figures are readable by caps, clothing, posture and concise skin/hand marks; portrait anatomy is not forced into tiny faces. Foreman portrait/background remain exact v01 retained candidates and are not flattened or silently approved.
findings.richness: The native pass preserves the large reference’s architectural/object ambition while quieting surface variation. Some source-defined contours remain; the result is disclosed as source-derived, not an independently drawn whole native scene.

ownerGate: Internal comparison supports presenting this consolidated review. Only Nate can approve/select the revised artwork; dimensions/counts/scaling/QA do not do so.
